source: Quiz 4 - Sessions 1-5: Building and Improving Agent Skills
question: What must you establish after saving a skill folder before relying on it in the intended host?

options.text: That the folder has been copied into several unrelated projects
options.feedback: Extra copies do not establish that the intended host has discovered and enabled the skill.

options.text: That the host has discovered and enabled the skill
options.feedback: Saving files and making them available for use in a host are distinct events. Check the destination environment.

options.text: That the agent reports successful installation in its final message
options.feedback: A completion claim is generated text. Inspect whether the destination actually discovered and enabled the skill.

options.text: That its text is identical to the version on a different machine
options.feedback: Matching text can help preserve a procedure, but does not establish that the destination can use it.
